senses.sense_definition: Any of several species of songbirds native to the Americas, having black, iridescent feathers and long tails.

examples.text: A common <w>grackle</w> landed on the fence post, its dark feathers shining bright purple in the sun.
We watched a loud flock of <w>grackles</w> gather in the park to search for food.

senses.sense_definition: Any of several Asian myna birds belonging to the genus Gracula, often kept as pets for their ability to mimic sounds.

examples.text: The hill <w>grackle</w> is well known for its remarkable ability to imitate human speech.
In the Asian aviary, a glossy black <w>grackle</w> called out loudly from a high branch.
